highlights: Customer Portal Settings Hub, OAuth & Session Management
changes: Customer Portal Settings Hub: Dedicated settings hub card (/settings/customer-portal) with granular controls for portal access, delivery channels, and session policies
Multi-Channel OTP Delivery: Select default OTP channel (WhatsApp or SMS) with real-time gateway readiness checks and automatic fallback to SMS
Google Sign-In & Social Identity: Fast one-click customer authentication with Google OAuth2 ID token verification, email auto-linking, and account management
Subscriber Account & Session Telemetry: Comprehensive subscriber overview (IP address, user-agent device info, session duration, and live session counts)
Remote Session Revocation & Password Reset: One-click session termination (Unauthenticate), bulk session revocation (Sign Out Everywhere), and portal password resets
Route & Middleware Hardening: Fixed Fiber route prefix overlap between staff admin (/customer-portal-admin) and customer portal (/portal)
